nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Bakuchiol Eye Cream

avis.titre: Wonderful for skin, but cannot be worn under makeup
avis.texte: I love what this cream does for my eyes, it brightens and soothes and is very sensitive skin friendly. But I got this as my day eye cream because it doesn't have retinol, and every time I try to put it on make up it pills up, rolls up, leaves peely layers, and I have to remove the makeup and the eye cream and put on something else so that I can wear makeup. I've tried different concealers and foundations and it does the same thing always.

Texture-wise, this is what really stood out to me: creamy but lightweight, in such a way that it doesn't feel greasy/heavy under the eyes. It absorbs pretty quickly and works well under sunscreen and concealer-zip pilling here. I love that it doesn't sting one bit, even on days when my skin barrier is acting up. It's also very light and refreshing. Result-wise, I didn't see dramatic wrinkle removal, but my under-eye area looks smoother and a bit brighter. The biggest difference was the dryness-my fine lines look softer because the area stays hydrated longer throughout the day. The bakuchiol seems gentle; I've reacted to retinol eye products before, but this didn't cause irritation or milia. It's more of a maintenance eye cream than an anti-aging one. If you have deep wrinkles/eyebags, you probably won't see huge changes. It works better as a preventive or soothing barrier-support eye cream rather than a corrective treatment. All in all, it feels like more of a daily eye cream for sensitive skin than a miracle worker — and I actually like that about it. I'd recomend it especially if retinol eye creams are too much for you but you want something that will improve the texture over time. It makes me feel super refreshed as a part of my skincare routine.

I've been using this eye cream for a couple of weeks now, and I think it's pretty good overall. It's not amazing, but it feels like a solid option for the price. The formula is rich and creamy, yet it still absorbs easily into the skin without feeling heavy or greasy. One of my favorite things about this product is the packaging—the tube has a soft, silicone doe-foot applicator that makes it really easy to apply exactly where you want. I like swiping it on and then gently patting it in. There's no noticeable scent, which is a plus for an eye cream. I haven't seen a big difference in the skin around my eyes yet, but it's still early. Ultimately, I'd give this a 3/5. It's good, but not great, and while I enjoyed using it, I probably wouldn't repurchase since there are stronger options out there. I received this product for free for my honest review.

I like the feeling of this applicator and cream, and it was good for hydration, but I have to admit that I wasn't super impressed with the wrinkle-reducing power it supposedly has. I have dark under eyes with deep creases sometimes and I really didn't see much a difference between using it and not. I received this product for free in exchange for my fair and honest review.
The packaging is very luxurious despite the product being very affordable. I love the applicator and how to fits perfectly under my eye. It also feels very hydrating.

I've had the pleasure of trying this product for free! This was definitely an interesting product, I tried it for over a month and I can say it's definitely going to permanently stay in my routine! It's easy and fun to apply, it doesn't make my eyes watery like other eye products tend to do and it feels very light and moisturizing. Great ingredients and no fragrance on this! Would definitely recommend to others to try out!

I received Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Bakuchiol Eye cream free to review . I have noticed a big difference with my eye area since using for a few weeks . It's a staple in my routine amazes with my results so far
The eye cream is smooth and plumping. It feels very refreshing after use and I can see a difference in my eye bags and wrinkles
This cream is small but mighty and a little goes a long way. I incorporated it pretty seamlessly into my routine. There is no irritation so far and the scent is light.

avis.titre: I plan to purchase this product once my tube runs out
avis.texte: I received a free full-sized tube of Madagascar Centella's Probio-Cica Bakuchiol Eye Cream in exchange for my honest review. I have been using it consistently for the past several weeks and am pleased with the results. The formulation is hydrating and the bakuchiol has been gently and subtly improving the appearance of my skin and under-eye lines without causing any discomfort. I have purchased and used numerous eye creams - which have either been packaged in a small tub/jar or in a tube with a metal roller ball applicator - and was pleasantly surprised by how much more I enjoy the silicone applicator tip. It is firm (doesn't have a lot of give) while remaining soft to the touch and most importantly doesn't drag my delicate skin as I'm applying the cream. I found it works best to squeeze the tube so enough product is dispensed, and then apply it to the under-eye (if you apply the cream while the dispenser is already on your under-eye sometimes too much product comes out). I plan to purchase another tube when I use this one up.

avis.titre: Nice but didn't work for me
avis.texte: I love the feel of this eye cream. It was nice and hydrating, and I love the packaging. I didn't see much of a difference after using it consistently but my skin felt nice.

So far we come to like it. This year, my bag, dark and puffy I have noticed a significant difference with the color and texture. I can tell the difference when I use it and when I don't. I like that it is thick and does not burn my eyes when I work out. I have really enjoyed using this.
This eye cream is deeply hydrating, and I use it every other night. It's been gentle on my skin with zero irritation. Plus, the packaging is adorable, and the applicator makes it even better.

I recently tried this eye cream from skin1004 and it works good! I do have dry to combination skin and this really hydrates my undereyes. This works as a base when I apply my makeup and makes my undereyes look so smooth. After using it for a while I noticed, my undereyes look more bright and hydrated!
Love this eye cream! The application is really nice and I have been seeing a difference in my eye area. I also love the clean ingredients.

Can't tell if it did anything so far. Maybe once I finish the tube then I can compare it with day 1 pic. When I first opened the product the cream kept coming out. Wasted a good of product cause of that. Besides all that I like how hydrating it is for my eyes. Not sure if I'm supposed toasty massage the cream with the applicator but that is what I do. Which makes it really convenient.

I had an opportunity to use this eye cream for about 3 weeks and it's very light formula and has no scent which is great. It is very absorbing and light. For my aging skin I might need a stronger formula.

Love the texture and how it spreads and makes the skin feel. It is moisturizing, however you have to be consistent to see chance 1 tube will not show any change. you need to use it for month or two to see progress.

I don't use many eye creams because I feel like they don't do much for me and are kinda gimmicky. That being said, I really enjoyed the Madagascar Centella eye cream. It feels super refreshing under my eyes and has become part of my eye routine. I've noticed that my normal eye discoloration seems slightly reduced and my eyes, that are very dry, don't feel as bad in the morning after using this.

avis.titre: I would purchase this product over and over again.
avis.texte: I use this comment before bed and wake up with the most perfect under eyes. I look like I just got a full nights rest in paradise.

I really enjoyed this eye cream. I am used to using retinol eye cream daily for the last 6 years to help my skin. I think the ingredients in this eye cream are wonderful and I love that the Bakuchol is not as irritating or drying on my eyes. I love how easy the applicator is to use and it is mess free which is a plus. Unfortunately this product isn't widely accessible in person at any of the stores near me but I would def buy online once I run out.
This eye cream is great, left my under eyes feeling very well moisturized and the applicator was great as well!

avis.titre: No good for dark under circles
avis.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I've been testing this for about 2-3 weeks and all I can say is my under eye area is maybe a little more hydrated than before. Unfortunately it's made no difference for my dark circles or my fine lines thus far. The product itself easily absorbs and the applicator is fun and easy to use.

The applicator on this product makes it so easy to use. It has a little bit of a plumping feeling to it, but it works amazing. I got results immediately and after a week of using it, my under eyes have definitely better.

I have enjoyed using this eye-cream in the last month. It is good to wear under makeup and before bed. I do wish it was a little heavier but regardless, it sits well under makeup without issues. I like that there is not a strong fragrance and the tube is nice. I am personally not a fan of the dispenser since it feels like it's dragging the skin under my eyes - I usually put some on my ring finger, warm up and apply as usual. Other than that, I think it's a great product for the price and amount.

I've been using this eye cream for about a week now and so far, I like it! It's too early to see any effects on my fine lines, but my under eyes do feel much more hydrated and my makeup applies great under my eyes. I apply at night before moisturizer. I've had no issues with irritation. Can't wait to keep using!

When I first got this product, I was pretty optimistic to see what it would do to the fine lines. I have around my eyes, and I can honestly say that they have met my expectations. I noticed that the skin around my eye did tighten a bit and left it looking firmer. I recommend this to anyone that wants to try it.

avis.titre: Interested in seeing long term use results
avis.texte: I've been using this for a few weeks now, and so far so good. The applicator makes it easy to apply, there is no scent, or no residue. It leaves my undereye feeling hydrated for the day.

The product has where you can just pull the top off to use and push-click it to close, which i like it's not the normal twist top. I've been enjoying the Probio Cica Baluchi Eye Cream. The applicator is great as it makes application easy and efficient. The texture is light but hydrating making it absorb quickly without leaving any residue. In my opinion, it's a good eye cream.

avis.titre: Gentle, Vegan, and Effective Eye Cream
avis.texte: I really like this SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Bakuchiol Eye Cream! I already use several products from this brand and they've become some of my absolute favorites. I love that this formula is vegan and very gentle, which is perfect for the delicate eye area. This eye cream helped a lot with the puffiness under my eyes, feels incredibly fresh, absorbs quickly, and never feels sticky. After using it, my skin looks brighter, smoother, and more awake. It's one of those products that truly makes a difference and I'm excited to keep it in my routine.

avis.titre: This is a good gentle moisturizer for younger folks
avis.texte: I love the packaging; sits in hand nicely and doesn't tip when put on the counter. The applicator is nice and thick, though plastic which isn't a big deal for me. The product has no fragrance which is a big deal for me and a texture of medium thickness cream - not too heavy but not gel like either. Absorbs in about 30 minutes. But I apply a good amount of product and use it on my upper lids too. The moisturizing and refreshing effect is clearly visible, as for wrinkle control my side wrinkles definitely appear smaller and overall the area looks and feels healthier and softer. This is a review of a free product received through a BzzAgent campaign

The first thing I really appreciated about this product is the applicatior it made distributing profit evenly easy. I love the clean ingredients and that there is no strong artificial smells. My eyes feel hydratred and I have no complains. Great price for the quality of the product. My eyes are important to me so I only want the best and this is best

avis.titre: A pleasant addition to a skincare routine
avis.texte: Thank you to skin1004 for the free sample of the Probio-Cica Bakuchiol Eye Cream! I have been using this product for a couple of weeks and have enjoyed it so far. The applicator is a shape and material that makes it useful for direct application, though I ultimately have preferred to use my fingers to apply. As someone with dark undereye circles, this product has not changed their appearance. However, I do think that my undereyes look smoother after application. Especially during the winter, this product has been helpful to retain moisture around the areas of my skin that are thinner. If I have leftover product after applying, I've also been using it on the fine lines around my mouth. While I haven't noticed any extreme improvements to my skin, this product has been soothing and an appreciated part of my nighttime routine.

avis.titre: I would buy this eye cream again
avis.texte: The cream is very silky smooth and absorbed quickly with no left residues. My under eye area is usually very sensitive and this cream was not irritating at all.
I really enjoyed using this eye cream. I didn't love the applicator as a plastic piece though. But the cream is very hydrating and moisturizing without being oily.

I received this as a free sample in exchange for a review. Madagascar Centella Probio Cica Bakuchiol Eye Cream has been a solid addition to my routine. I love that it comes in a tube so I don't have to dip my fingers into a pot. The texture feels moisturizing without leaving any greasy residue and it sits nicely under makeup without pilling. I haven't noticed a dramatic change in fine lines but at 40 I don't expect any eye cream to work miracles. I can't speak to how it performs on dark circles since that's not a concern for me but overall it's a dependable gentle formula that keeps the area smooth and comfortable.

A lightweight, 20 ml eye cream packed with fermented Centella Asiatica, bakuchiol (vegan retinol), niacinamide, ceramides, hyaluronic acid, and soothing botanicals. It comes with a handy silicone‑tip applicator for gentle, mess‑free application. It has light‑creamy texture that glides on smoothly and absorbs fast, no stickiness or greasy film. It's Fragrance‑free, which is a win for sensitive eyes. It's Hydrating & calming with Centella and panthenol soothe, while ceramides reinforce the barrier. Bakuchiol works like a gentle retinol, helping smooth fine lines without the typical irritation. Nice applicator with the wide tip lets you swipe and pat the product under the eye without touching it with your fingers. Effect on wrinkles/dark circles is mild, noticeable results take time and it may not replace a stronger retinol eye cream for advanced signs. If you have normal‑to‑dry or sensitive skin and want a calming, moisturizing eye cream that gently tackles early signs of aging, this one hits the mark. It's especially good for first‑time bakuchiol users. For deeper wrinkles or stubborn dark circles, you might need something with a higher retinol potency.

The Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Bakuchiol Eye Cream works so well. I love the large applicator and the product glides on very smoothly with product on the tip. I used thr eye cream morning and night for a few weeks and love how you dont need to use alot of product to get coverage, it absorbs quickly,the applicator tip is easy to clean, and my under eye area has increased hydration and just looks better. I love that using just one tube I can see results.
I really like this eye cream. My under eyes got crepey with the cold weather. This eye cream did the trick. My under eyes are nice and smooth after a few uses.
I love this eye cream, I love how moisturizing it is without feeling oily. I also love the applicator tip on the tub it make for a quick and easy application.

I received this product for free from SKIN1004. I use this eye cream every night and I love that the formula is very lightweight. It doesn't irritate my eyes at all and the silicone tip makes it easy to apply directly to the under eyes. Also, it gets absorbed easily and there's no residue/stickiness at all. My under eyes look very smooth after applying.

Absolutely love this eye cream in comparison to my old one. I love that it's not greasy or sticky. Love the packaging and it's very easy to apply. I'm already seeing results. My fine wrinkles are now more smooth now. Will definitely buy again. Recommending this to all my friends!

So lucky I got to sample this product! I'm obsessed with this Centella Probiotic-Cica Bakuchiol Eye Cream! The formula is soothing, brightening, and absorbs beautifully—but the applicator is what really sold me. Its shape is designed to hit the eye area perfectly, making it so easy to distribute the product evenly and gently. My under-eyes already look smoother and more refreshed. Truly a new skincare staple—highly recommend!

avis.titre: I would purchase this again and again!
avis.texte: I'm not too far into my bottle but I am truly loving this eye cream! It's lightweight and glides easily across the skin. The applicator is convenient as well but I still find I use my finger rather than drag the applicator around my eye. I'm excited to see continued results as I progress with the bottle! I was gifted this product but would purchase once I'm out!

This eye cream is nice. It's lightweight and spreads easily. Sometimes when eye creams are too heavy, I get bumps under my eyes. That doesn't happen with this one! It feels hydrating and the applicator is nice. My only complaint is that the lid comes off too easily. I received this product free for review but all opinions are my own.

This eye cream is incredible! The texture is super lightweight but still really hydrating, and it absorbs beautifully without feeling greasy. After just a few uses, my under-eye area looks smoother, brighter, and way more refreshed. The bakuchiol is gentle but effective, and I love that it doesn't irritate my skin at all. Truly a high-quality product — I'll definitely repurchase!

avis.titre: Super smooth hydrating eye cream. LOVE!!
avis.texte: From the texture of this product to the applicator, this eye cream is a 10/10. Not only does it leave my undereyes feeling glowy and hydrated, it sits beautifully under makeup as well. I'm excited to continue using to keep my eye area feeling refreshed as it becomes colder and dryer outside.
